decisions.statement: The page a folder is named against is the nearest page above that folder.
A folder named for a part is looked through when that page is looked for.
A folder named for a part that holds a page is that page's own folder.
The name a folder is asked for has the opening that name shares with that page taken off.
That opening is taken off again while the name left still opens with such a name.
The folder with nothing above it is asked for no name.
Which names are a part's are handed in rather than written here.
A name the folder does not carry yet is asked against that page the same way.
A rename asks that name here rather than working the name out again.

definition: the name a folder is asked for, and the page that name is asked against
